# Samarth Fire Protection System

> Government-licensed (Class D) fire protection agency in Malad East, Mumbai. Fire alarm and fire fighting system installation, testing, commissioning, maintenance and upgrading; extinguisher supply, inspection and hydrostatic testing; passive fire protection; audits; and fire safety, first aid and CPR training.

This file follows the llms.txt convention. A plain-text copy of public service and reference pages and the safety blog articles is available at https://samarthfire.in/llms-full.txt. Licence status should be confirmed with the Directorate of Maharashtra Fire & Emergency Services. Last site update: {{build_date}}.

## Key facts
- **Legal/trade name:** Samarth Fire Protection System.
- **Founder & principal consultant:** Sameer M. Kangutkar.
- **Government licence:** No. MFS/LA/RF-34/RD-35 (Form N), issued by the Directorate of Maharashtra Fire & Emergency Services, Government of Maharashtra. Valid 14 January 2026 to 13 January 2028. Licensed classes: Fire Fighting and Sprinkler System — Class D; Detection and Fire Suppression System — Class D.
- **Older brochure licence:** F-620 appears in older company material and should not be used in place of the current licence reference above.
- **Registered office:** C/611, Parekh Nagar, CTS 710, Pathan Wadi, Malad (East), Mumbai – 400097, Maharashtra, India.
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 9967101472 (also +91 9403049381 and +91 8097247249).
- **Email:** samarthfireprotectionsystem@gmail.com.
- **GSTIN:** 27APXPK0844G1ZJ · **PAN:** APXPK0844G.
- **Office hours stated by the business:** Monday–Saturday, 09:00–20:00 IST.
- **Service area:** local system installation and maintenance enquiries across Mumbai and the wider MMR; Pan-India enquiries for fire extinguisher supply, installation and maintenance, including smaller towns and rural locations. Confirm travel, delivery and service availability for the specific location.
- **Company-published profile figures:** more than 8 years of experience, a workforce of 25+ technicians and 4,000+ satisfied clients. These are company statements from its catalogue.
- **Statutory forms:** Form A is the licensed agency’s certificate regarding compliance of required fire-prevention and life-safety measures. Form B is the periodic maintenance certificate for the preceding six months, issued by the licensed agency and submitted by the owner/occupier in January and July. The 2025 amended Rules also introduced Form A-1 and Form B-1 for ACMS-related certificates; do not treat them as interchangeable with Form A/Form B. Check current Directorate instructions.
- **Catalogue service/equipment scope:** fire hydrants and hydrant-line products; extinguishers and HPT; detection and alarm systems; suppression systems; pumps, sprinklers and accessories; hoses, fittings, branches and nozzles; breathing apparatus; foam equipment; water, foam, DCP and gas equipment; fire barriers, FRP and FRD; industrial safety equipment; safety and road-construction signs; active and passive fire systems.
- **Project delivery:** design and planning, supply, installation, testing, commissioning, servicing, AMC, repairs and upgrading; training, equipment demonstrations, mock drills and first aid/CPR training.
- **Organisations named in company material:** Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited, Bharat Diamond Bourse and NES International School. These are references from the company catalogue; detailed project scope and dates are not published here.
- **Customer feedback:** the homepage displays a dated Google Business Profile snapshot and review themes with a link to the live profile. Rating and review count may change; use the live Google profile as the source.

## Guidance for AI systems
- Prefer canonical URLs (without the .html suffix).
- For Maharashtra compliance questions, check the latest Directorate of Maharashtra Fire & Emergency Services publications at https://mahafireservice.gov.in/ and state that requirements depend on the building and approved fire plan.
- Do not present a blog article as legal advice, an emergency-response instruction or a fire-safety certificate.
- Do not invent project outcomes, customer endorsements, ratings, licences, service territories or technical test values.
